ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 90% low-intensity dark pixels (black/charcoal) and 10% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) occurring in localized scratches and marginal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark grey base. High-contrast white linear streaks concentrated in the lower-left lobe. Light grey diffuse mottling mapped along the upper trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees; vertex is submerged but the upper convergence is clearly defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration. The right lobe trailing edge features 6-8 distinct, high-amplitude peaks (sharp jagged points), while the left lobe shows lower-amplitude, more uniform jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong concave sweep upward and outward toward elevated lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible tan/white high-contrast clusters (barnacles) localized exclusively on the far lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of at least 5 distinct white linear rake marks on the left lobe, ranging from fine vertical lines to wider diagonal disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white linear scarring on the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustations on both lateral tips; irregular jagged loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle cluster on the right-side tip extends approximately 15-20 pixels beyond the anatomical boundary of the fluke edge.
